verdict.summary:
Doc-only change to research/change-based-test-selection.md: replaces the stale "Deferred (proceed-and-document)" paragraph about the §6.1 selection-bug alarm with a two-line "Shipped (sq-va7at, PR #1526)" note. This is a pure honesty-reconciliation edit, and every factual claim it makes verifies against the repository.

Verification performed:
- Attribution: `git log` confirms commit 56e08c7f "ci(selection): nightly change-based-selection bug alarm (sq-va7at) (#1526)", so both the bead id and the PR number are correct; the doc update simply lands late.
- "correlates failed nightly jobs with suspect landed PRs": .github/workflows/selection-alarm.yml fires via workflow_run only when the CI run concluded `failure` on a `schedule`/`workflow_dispatch` event on main, and scripts/ci_selection_alarm.py `correlate()` intersects failed-job crate tokens with the per-commit skip sets replayed over the since-last-green-nightly window. Claim holds.
- "auto-files a deduplicated issue": `create_issue()` files via `gh issue create`; dedup is a stable `<!-- selection-alarm-key: ... -->` body marker exact-matched against open issues. I specifically checked the dedup path for the classic label mismatch (search label not applied at creation): BASE_LABELS = ["selection-alarm", "auto"] and `open_issue_exists()` lists `--label selection-alarm`, so the search set and the filed set agree. No silent dedup failure.
- Test validity: scripts/tests/test_ci_selection_alarm.py runs 17 tests, all green locally. They are non-vacuous — they exercise the real `correlate()`/`job_crate_tokens()` logic, include a substring-collision guard (sparq-core must not match sparq-core-foo), a non-spam property (empty skip set ⇒ no finding), an infra-lane-failure-is-not-triaged case, fail-loud exits on replay error / empty failed-jobs set, and a regex pinned against the real ci.yml shard job name. Wired into CI via docs-quality.yml.
